production_order: After the roadmap carousel; before the YouTube reference.
concept: A one-word button edit spirals into localization, customer profiles and email infrastructure.
originality: New dialogue, fictional UI, counts, assistant design and owner footage. Reference structure only; no source footage, audio, logo, handle or other likeness in output.
avatar_instruction: Keep the approved avatar/look. Do not create another look or substitute a third-party likeness. Hammad’s bright casual presence anchors each human line.
delivery: Natural owner cadence. Conversational spoken passages around140–160wpm where comfortable, plus purposeful pauses and animation. Do not time-stretch to the old219wpm target. Actual measured take controls final anchors.
assistant_design: Original small floating ring-shaped assistant: pale neutral body, one centered eye, two short fins, soft blue status glow; no cube, orange rectangular body, short-leg silhouette, Claude logo or Anthropic mascot. Use existing owner brand colors when verified in production.
assistant_voice: Prefer a clearly labeled character performance with the same approved owner voice and natural cadence, or an already-authorized licensed generic assistant voice if one is documented. Do not extract/clone the reference voice, pitch-shift the owner, or choose a new paid voice without scope authorization.

keyword_reason: Original generic keyword for an original small-change checklist; do not repeat unverified30-skill offer.
cta: Keep CTA in post copy, matching reference placement. Draft: Comment SCOPE for my small-change checklist. Use only after resource page and delivery path are verified; neither exists as a deployed result of this analysis.
resource_draft: Name the exact element and desired change.
State which existing behavior must stay the same.
Ask for the smallest relevant change and explain any necessary dependency.
Inspect the diff and verify the rendered result.
Treat unexpected new features as a separate request.
cover_spec: Hammad reaction as large portrait in approved bright casual setting, owner wordmark in existing brand style above; single bold short line across upper chest: ONE WORD. 24 FILES? No source sign, face, watermark or product logo. Keep head/line safe within platform crops.
caption_style_to_match: One phrase/sentence at a time; bold sans serif with subtle shadow, developer/assistant differentiated by text label or scene plus color. Increase readability to about26–30px at720px, two lines maximum. Center around60–66% height only where clear; adapt position to avoid UI controls. Use owner approved font/colors when checked.
effects: Clean hard cuts and one code-card cascade per escalation beat. Optional single depth-ui beat only if readability improves; no required one-click effects and no stacking. video-effects skill consulted.
screen_recording_requirement: No external product workflow is demonstrated. Use original animated UI props visibly presented as a skit. Do not record a real signup or call a product to force overengineering. If a real live-demo version is later requested, it is a different production task needing actual evidence.
audio: Preserve approved voice unsped and unpitched. No source audio reuse. Original/licensed quiet music may sit below voice; isolated card/typing cues on the two cascades, brief quiet at the error, interruption as the end. Keep intentional joke pauses.
reference_flaws_and_fixes: Tiny code/captions: prioritize large meaningful cards and readable phrases.
Dark compressed faces: approved bright owner look and clear UI contrast.
Dense placeholder code: original schematic labels, clearly fictional.
Source branding/character identity: replace every asset.
Ending easily truncated: retain verification error, second cascade, interruption.
Unverified30-item offer: original scope checklist, only offer after delivery is ready.
